```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE, fig.retina = 2)

required_pkgs <- c("tidyverse", "patchwork", "ggrepel")
missing_pkgs <- required_pkgs[!required_pkgs %in% installed.packages()[, "Package"]]
if (length(missing_pkgs) > 0) install.packages(missing_pkgs)

library(tidyverse)
library(patchwork)

```

```{r parameters}
csv_path    <- "tpm_variant_count_relationship_stats.csv"
alpha       <- 0.05
out_prefix  <- "Figure_TPM_variant_correlation"
```

```{r load-and-categorize}
df <- read_csv(csv_path, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  mutate(
    gene_group  = factor(gene_group, levels = c("AD-enriched", "CN-enriched", "Shared")),
    ad_sig      = !is.na(ad_pvalue) & ad_pvalue < alpha,
    control_sig = !is.na(control_pvalue) & control_pvalue < alpha,
    diff_sig    = !is.na(diff_pvalue) & diff_pvalue < alpha,
    sig_group = case_when(
      ad_sig & control_sig  ~ "Both significant",
      ad_sig & !control_sig ~ "AD only",
      !ad_sig & control_sig ~ "Control (CN) only",
      TRUE                  ~ "Neither significant"
    ),
    sig_group = factor(sig_group, levels = c(
      "Neither significant", "AD only", "Control (CN) only", "Both significant"
    )),
    diff_sig_label = if_else(
      diff_sig, "Significantly different", "Not significantly different"
    ),
    diff_sig_label = factor(diff_sig_label, levels = c(
      "Not significantly different", "Significantly different"
    ))
  )

# colorblind-safe (RColorBrewer "Dark2")
sig_colors <- c(
  "Neither significant" = "grey80",
  "AD only"              = "#1B9E77",
  "Control (CN) only"    = "#D95F02",
  "Both significant"     = "#7570B3"
)
outline_colors <- c(
  "Not significantly different"           = "grey60",
  "Significantly different" = "black"
)
```

```{r panelA, fig.width=9, fig.height=3.6}

plot_df  <- df %>% filter(!is.na(ad_rho), !is.na(control_rho))


panelA <- ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = ad_rho, y = control_rho)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dotted", color = "grey60", linewidth = 0.4) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dotted", color = "grey60", linewidth = 0.4) +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey50", linewidth = 0.4) +
  geom_point(aes(fill = sig_group, color = diff_sig_label),
             shape = 21, size = 2.4, stroke = 0.9, alpha = 0.85) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = sig_colors, breaks = names(sig_colors),
                    name = "Significant correlations (p-value < 0.05)") +
  scale_color_manual(values = outline_colors, breaks = names(outline_colors),
                     name = "Significant difference between\nconditions (p-value < 0.05)") +
  coord_fixed(xlim = c(-1, 1), ylim = c(-1, 1)) +
  facet_wrap(~ gene_group, nrow = 1) +
  labs(
    x = expression(paste("Spearman ", rho, " (AD)")),
    y = expression(paste("Spearman ", rho, " (Control)"))
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 11) +
  theme(
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey95", color = NA),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.box = "vertical",
    legend.margin = margin(t = -5),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 9),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 8)
  ) +
  guides(
    fill  = guide_legend(override.aes = list(shape = 21, color = "grey40", stroke = 0.6, alpha = 1), nrow = 2, order = 1),
    color = guide_legend(override.aes = list(shape = 21, fill = "white", stroke = 0.9, alpha = 1), order = 2)
  )

panelA
```

```{r panelB, fig.width=4, fig.height=3.6}

summary_df <- df %>%
  count(gene_group, sig_group, .drop = FALSE) %>%
  group_by(gene_group) %>%
  mutate(pct = 100 * n / sum(n)) %>%
  ungroup()

panelB <- ggplot(summary_df, aes(x = gene_group, y = pct, fill = sig_group)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.65, color = "white", linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = ifelse(n > 0, n, "")),
    position = position_stack(vjust = 0.5), size = 2.6, color = "white"
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = sig_colors, guide = "none") +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "% of genes in group") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 11) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 20, hjust = 1)
  )

panelB
```


```{r combine-figure, fig.width=10, fig.height=4}
library(patchwork)
library(grid)

# extract collected legend, then strip legends from the panels themselves
legend_grob <- cowplot::get_legend(
  panelA + theme(legend.position = "bottom", legend.box = "vertical")
)

panelA_noleg <- panelA + theme(legend.position = "none")
panelB_noleg <- panelB  # already guide = "none"

top_row <- panelB_noleg + panelA_noleg + plot_layout(widths = c(1, 2.3))
bottom_row <- wrap_elements(legend_grob) + plot_spacer() +
  plot_layout(widths = c(0, 0))

combined <- top_row / bottom_row +
  plot_layout(heights = c(3, 1)) +
  plot_annotation(tag_levels = list(c("A", "B", "", "")))

combined
```

```{r save-figure}
ggsave(paste0(out_prefix, ".pdf"),  combined, width = 10, height = 4, units = "in", dpi = 300)
ggsave(paste0(out_prefix, ".tiff"), combined, width = 10, height = 4, units = "in",
       dpi = 300, compression = "lzw")
ggsave(paste0(out_prefix, ".png"),  combined, width = 10, height = 4, units = "in", dpi = 300)

message("saved: ", out_prefix, ".pdf / .tiff / .png")
```
